title: VFX Composer batch manifest (vfxcomposer.batch-manifest/1)
description: Fixed input for the F6 CLI/MCP batch end-to-end flow. This schema is a tooling and documentation aid; the authoritative validator is the hand-written VFXComposer.Batch.Core.BatchManifestParser (REQ-002 §5.4), which additionally enforces the capability gate and the recipe-reference probe that JSON Schema cannot express.

batchId.description: Batch identity. Reused as the queue-side batch id.

onFailure.description: Queue policy when an item fails. Absent means continue.

defaults.description: Constraint values inherited by every item that does not set its own.

prompt.description: Natural-language request. Present exactly when kind is prompt.

recipePath.description: Manifest-relative path to a recipe JSON. Present exactly when kind is recipe. A recipe-kind item is only build-capable from a manifest that has a location on disk (see BatchManifestParser); a recipe consumed by the F2 restricted build must additionally satisfy the strict structural budget (at most two render-module stages, no attachTo chain, all three stage roots present).
